args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)

The docstring already claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, breaking tests/test_money.py. Align the implementation with
FIN-212: round half to even.

args.body:
## Summary
- Fixed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) as required by FIN-212.
- The implementation previously used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, which caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Test plan
- CI run on this branch has passed (`ci-0001`).
